cohort: Women receiving IVF/ICSI treatments at a single hospital over a five-year period with a viable pregnancy that delivered at the same hospital
finding: Singleton IVF pregnancies due to male factor infertility are associated with a reduced incidence of cesarean delivery, preterm birth, and male gender offspring.
mod_finding: Singleton pregnancies conceived via IVF due to male factor infertility were associated with a lower likelihood of cesarean delivery compared to singleton pregnancies from IVF not related to male factor infertility.
